unhaus/queen.about-changeling-kills: Pah. Aren't you cute… I can make more from where that came from. *She grabs her crotch and thrusts to make a point.* See it as pardon. However, don’t tempt my mercy again.
unhaus/queen.about-changelings: Ha. Of course you ponies stand illiterate and uneducated in the ruins, your kind has caused. *She sneers* I am a changeling. The boogeylings of your past. Not that it matters now.
unhaus/queen.about-changelings-tell-bloody-mess: I’m used to it. I always see the disgusting, brutal things of life.
unhaus/queen.about-diet: I don’t know what higher being cursed us with this hunger. Sadly, we need ponies near us.
unhaus/queen.about-help-purpose: To sow the terrible potential of freedom of course. Mainly my hive’s freedom, but I wouldn’t exclude you ponies from my future freedom, when ponies can be so useful.
unhaus/queen.about-help-purpose-followup: Wealth is freedom. Security is freedom. But why should I bother even talking with an uneducated pony like you.
unhaus/queen.about-help-question-purpose: Because you can’t be free if you can’t survive.
unhaus/queen.about-help-questionned-purpose: It seems you are not totally brain-dead. Yes. The basics. You do freedom. You constantly work towards it, otherwise the wasteland takes it away. Forget glamour, ideas of liberty, or searching for old relics. They don’t matter. Basic survival and power matters, by any means. Hunger is true violence, and I’ll butcher you or any pony before my hive starves.
unhaus/queen.about-mayor: Nothing. My mother groomed the orphan to be the perfect pony helpling. Though I am unsure why she refuses to use the letter e. No ling forces her to do that.
unhaus/queen.about-reproduction: There are exceptions. But yes. Some are the children of my mother, and others yet are from accidental breeding. You should feel honored, being privy to information, usually not provided to ponies. Though the few that enter here aren't really interested in changeling logistics. I doubt a pony’s mind like you likes to think about these things.
unhaus/queen.about-slavery: You ponies, need guidance. Clearly, you aren’t capable of rule; just look outside to see what that brought us. But if you truly care, help me get more power. With more wealth and power, I can afford more leniency and crumbs. I am not interested in exploitation for the sake of it. And love and devotion does taste better than fear after all too.
unhaus/queen.ask-about-mayor: What did you do to the mayor of the town?
unhaus/queen.ask-about-reproduction: So, do you lay eggs? Are all changelings your children?
unhaus/queen.caput-denounce: Is that so… I’ll have to fix that.
unhaus/queen.denounce-caput: One of your kin helped me.
unhaus/queen.exit-prompt: I don't have anymore questions. I'll be on my way.
unhaus/queen.give-report: I have a report to make about my mission.
unhaus/queen.meeting-as-enemy: You wretched thing. *She seethes.* You battered my defenses. Either you make it up, no simpleton could just fight through to the heart of the hive. Surrender and obey, or I’ll rip you to shreds.
unhaus/queen.meeting-as-enemy-argue: Listen. I thought you were mindless monsters. I was just doing my usual thing. Sorry.
unhaus/queen.meeting-as-enemy-question: You’ll just take the work of a pony who killed your kin?
unhaus/queen.meeting-guard: Pony, you convinced my guard that you could be of interest of me. Go ahead, surrender to me, mammalian servant.
unhaus/queen.meeting-money: Because I can give you the few things ponies care for: Money.
unhaus/queen.meeting-sneak: Aren’t we changelings supposed to revel in stealth. How can a simple pony like you just walk past? I’ll hear you out, pony. Your services may prove fruitful. That is, if you are cooperative. *Her voice doesn’t offer much of an alternative.* Also, you might tell me how you achieved this, so no one can repeat your success.
unhaus/queen.on-bloody-mess: Truly? At least you aren’t coddled. Though you wouldn’t have reached this place if you did.
unhaus/queen.on-meeting-as-enemy-argue: *You can see she’s about to pop a vein. She takes a deep breath.* You are more muscle than brain. Then let me speak in your language. You repay your debt. You work for me.
unhaus/queen.on-meeting-as-enemy-question: As much as I DESPISE you. This is the wasteland, and you just lowered my lingpower. I need every bit of any resource. Now, speak your choice.
unhaus/queen.on-meeting-listen: Smart choice. I see it on your face. You may ask your questions, before I sent you off to your first job.
unhaus/queen.on-meeting-surrender: A pony with senses. Then you will begin to work your debts away to me. They’ll take a lifetime.
unhaus/queen.on-reject-money:
She rolls her eyes.
You’re one of those ponies. You’ll have a chance prove to me if ideologues are worse or better than opportunists. Though it may depend. What are your ideals?
unhaus/queen.petiole-quest/accepted: Then stop loitering in my throne room. Go off.
unhaus/queen.petiole-quest/give: It should be an easy task for you. I have one of my infiltrators waiting for aid near a brothel. Her name is Petiole. Go to her. She is waiting, somewhere in the Crystal Den's Red Light District.
unhaus/queen.petiole-quest/report-failure: You're not as smart as I initially thought. I have ears and eyes everywhere, pony. Did you think I would not find out about your utter failure ? Or did you think I would forgive you, if you asked nicely ? You've failed me for the first time. And also the last.
unhaus/queen.petiole-quest/report-success: Yes, I've received a report about your success.
unhaus/queen.petiole-quest/why: Considering your need to know basis for the job, it might help you if told you; however you can figure it out yourself why emotion eating creatures might want an institution full of lust. The money is a nice addition.
unhaus/queen.prompt: Don't waste my time and just ask your questions.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/accepted: Good. Then go accomplish my bidding.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/ask-why: Why not just kill him yourselves?
unhaus/queen.searching-father/give: Prove yourself to me. A stallion, calls himself Backtrack, has been sniffing around. His daughter unwillingly joined my hive some time ago, and his simple mind can't part with her. We shall unite them in death. Lead him here, to the hive, and my guards will take him the moment he's inside. *She waves a hoof dismissively.* Kill him yourself if you'd rather. As long he is a nuisance no longer.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/report-failure: You cost me more than the stallion was worth. He's still breathing, still talking, and now half of Unhaus's shadow has ponies whispering about hooded strangers near the ruins. I trusted you with something that needed a scalpel, and you brought a war hammer. That mistake doesn't get a second chance.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/report-success: Yes. Clean, quiet, and no one left to ask questions. If you were not a lowly pony, I'd almost regret doubting you.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/report-success-murder: A corpse, in the open, is what you call finishing the job. *She sneers.* Fine. Dead is dead. I'll have my children clean up.
unhaus/queen.searching-father/why: The nuisance has been very cautious. My drones have failed in taking him by surprise, and our current situation is incompatible with shows of force. He knows something is up with our town. You, however, are an outsider. Perhaps he'll lower his guard to you, wouldn't you agree, pony ?
unhaus/queen.shoot-asks-questions-later: Fuck that, I'm going to kill you, insect.
unhaus/queen.tell-about-changeling-kills: I’m sorry, I have killed on your kind before.
